batch: Twelve reviewed hand interaction and generation assembly sources

record.name: 卑劣的脏鼠
record.text: 嘲讽。战吼：&使你的对手随机从手牌中召唤一个随从。
record.text_en: [x]Taunt Battlecry:& Your opponent summons a random minion from their hand.

record.name: 侏儒吸血鬼
record.text: 战吼：&移除你对手的牌库顶的一张牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry:& Remove the top card of your opponent's deck.

record.name: 哈尔拉兹，山猫之神
record.text: 突袭。战吼：&用1/1并具有突袭的山猫填满你的手牌。
record.text_en: Rush. Battlecry:& Fill your hand with 1/1 Lynxes that have Rush.

record.name: 始源领主
record.text: 战吼：&随机获取一张来自过去的巨型随从牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry:& Get a random Colossal minion from the past.

record.name: 播种的绿龙
record.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机获取一张龙牌，其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
record.text_en: [x]Taunt Deathrattle:& Get a random __Dragon. It costs (2) less.

record.name: 时间机器
record.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机获取一张回溯牌。

record.name: 消散的回忆
record.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（5）的随从牌。
record.text_en: Deathrattle:& Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.

record.name: 时空冰封勇士
record.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张传说随从牌，其法力值消耗减少（1）点。
record.text_en: Deathrattle:& Get a random Legendary minion. Reduce its Cost by (1).

record.name: 抛石鱼人
record.text: 战吼：&获取一张法力值消耗为（1）的石头。石头可以造成$3点伤害。
record.text_en: Battlecry:& Get a 1-Cost Rock that deals $3 damage.

record.name: 坑道恐怪
record.text: 亡语：&随机获取两张临时的法力值消耗为（2）的随从牌。

record.name: 暮光治愈者
record.text: 亡语：&随机获取神圣和暗影法术牌各一张。
record.text_en: Deathrattle:& Get a random Holy and Shadow spell.

face.name: 卑劣的脏鼠
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：&使你的对手随机从手牌中召唤一个随从。
face.flavorText: 脏鼠以前并不脏，直到他丢掉了肥皂。

face.name: Dirty Rat
face.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Your opponent summons a random minion from their hand.
face.flavorText: It's not his fault… Someone keeps stealing his soap!

face.name: 末日守卫
face.text: 冲锋。战吼：&随机弃两张牌。
face.flavorText: 召唤末日守卫有很大的风险。总得有人付出生命的代价。

face.name: Doomguard
face.text: Charge. Battlecry:& Discard two random cards.
face.flavorText: Summoning a doomguard is risky. Someone is going to die.

face.name: 侏儒吸血鬼
face.text: 战吼：&移除你对手的牌库顶的一张牌。
face.flavorText: 她更喜欢别人叫她“吸血靓妹”。

face.name: Gnomeferatu
face.text: Battlecry:& Remove the top card of your opponent's deck.
face.flavorText: She prefers the term "Glampire."

face.name: 哈尔拉兹，山猫之神
face.text: 突袭。战吼：&用1/1并具有突袭的山猫填满你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 山猫种群的强度取决于最弱的那一只。

face.name: Halazzi, the Lynx
face.text: Rush. Battlecry:& Fill your hand with 1/1 Lynxes that have Rush.
face.flavorText: Remember, you’re only as strong as your weakest lynx.

face.name: 始源领主
face.text: 战吼：&随机获取一张来自过去的巨型随从牌。
face.flavorText: 在那冰冷的黑曜石铠甲之下，他的心……如熔岩一般炽烈。

face.name: Primordial Lord
face.text: Battlecry:& Get a random Colossal minion from the past.
face.flavorText: Behind his cold obsidian armor, he has a heart of... molten rock.

face.name: 播种的绿龙
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机获取一张龙牌，其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 为下一个“独角兽德鲁伊”埋下了种子。

face.name: Seeding Dragon
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Get a random Dragon. It costs (2) less.
face.flavorText: Seeding support for a future "Unicorn Druid".

face.name: 时间机器
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机获取一张回溯牌。
face.flavorText: 博士，你居然造出了时间机器……用冰箱造的？

face.name: Time Machine
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Get a random Rewind card.
face.flavorText: Doc, you made a time machine... out of a refrigerator?

face.name: 消散的回忆
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（5）的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 我想到了一条绝妙的卡牌趣文……怎么又忘了？

face.name: Fading Memory
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.
face.flavorText: I had the best idea for flavor text! …what was it again?

face.name: 时空冰封勇士
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张传说随从牌，其法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 勇士的笑容渐渐凝固……

face.name: Cryofrozen Champion
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random Legendary minion. Reduce its Cost by (1).
face.flavorText: If you keep making that face it's going to freeze like that.

face.name: 抛石鱼人
face.text: 战吼：&获取一张法力值消耗为（1）的石头。石头可以造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 小石头，像皮球，一扔扔进溪水流。

face.name: Rockskipper
face.text: Battlecry:& Get a 1-Cost Rock that deals 3 damage.
face.flavorText: Don't step on a stream or you'll break your mama's spleen.

face.name: 坑道恐怪
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取两张临时的法力值消耗为（2）的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 唇下再留一撮小胡子就更棒了。

face.name: Tunnel Terror
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get two random Temporary 2-Cost minions.
face.flavorText: And a tiny soul patch to match.

face.name: 暮光治愈者
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取神圣和暗影法术牌各一张。
face.flavorText: 墓晨林地里到处都是难以决断的牧师。

face.name: Twilight Mender
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random Holy and Shadow spell.
face.flavorText: The Gravedawn Glade is FULL of indecisive Priests.

face.name: 山猫
face.text: 突袭

face.name: Lynx
face.text: Rush

face.name: 石头
face.text: 造成 3点伤害。

face.name: Rock
face.text: Deal 3 damage.
